import pandas as pd

def main():
    # List all source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/test_0.csv"
    ]

    # Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source file
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Ensure schema correctness: 'condition' as int, 'click' as float
        df = df.astype({'condition': 'int64', 'click': 'float64'})
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Group by 'condition' and aggregate 'click' by average as per hints
    result_df = combined_df.groupby('condition', as_index=False)['click'].mean()

    # Cast 'condition' to int and 'click' to float explicitly to match target schema
    result_df = result_df.astype({'condition': 'int64', 'click': 'float64'})

    # Write the result to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_87/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    result_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
